errors.evidence: The figure displays 6 main categories in the primary pie chart and 4 sub-categories in the secondary chart. The total number of unique categories shown is 9 (A, B, C, E, F, D0, D1, D2, D3), not 8.
The description claims the categories are listed in order ('依次为'), but the list is not in descending order of value, as F (7.1%) is listed before A (9%).
